fields.description: Issue includes an editorial prediction about newspaper-labor relations and coverage asserting the revival of the Dade County city-county consolidation/merger issue. A major article links Rev. Joseph Barth (First Unitarian Church) with psychiatrist T. Earl Moore ("Granada Psychiatric Clinic"), reproducing a letter and alleging harmful treatment of a patient (Lee/Kay Head). Other stories discuss a major new oil well in the Sunniland field (Collier County) and implications for South Florida; Gov. Fuller Warren’s admission of past Klan membership; municipal court and jail "clean-up" efforts; Miami high school oratorical contests promoting "Americanism" and opposition to communism; a preview of Dr. Alfred C. Kinsey’s public discussion on marriage relations; an exposé on spiritualist mediums and alleged fraud; and a reprinted report on studies linking heavy cigarette smoking with lung cancer. Includes legal notices and extensive local advertisements/entertainment listings.
